reader_flags.reason: Direct bucket-handle medial tear positive. Contusion positive uses final explicitly traumatic marrow edema; body localizes femur whereas conclusion localizes tibia, an unresolved anatomical discrepancy preserved in full quote, but both are within the reported knee and neither negates traumatic marrow injury. Explicit_absence: intact ACL/MCL/lateral meniscus/cartilage. Missing_evidence: fluid lacks amount; normal bone form amid marrow injury does not explicitly exclude an acute line. Synovitis/Baker unmentioned. Flag bone-localization/source inference for review.

Direct surfacing medial meniscal tear positive. Explicit_absence/below_threshold: mild mucoid ACL, normal MCL/lateral meniscus, small fluid and no Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: femorotibial bare gradeI does not establish cartilage thickness; PF fissures exceed 70% depth but their regional extent is unspecified, and bare patellar I/II adds no precise depth. Bone osteophytes alone do not assess contusion/fracture; both unmentioned. Thick plica is not synovitis.

Below_threshold: ACL myxoid signal and lateral grade-I degeneration. Explicit_absence: normal bone signal for contusion. Missing_evidence: MCL surrounding edema lacks fiber status; medial bare gradeIII/extrusion lacks direct tear; slight fluid around knee has uncertain joint versus periarticular localization, so do not grade effusion from it. Bone signal alone does not exclude acute cortical line. Cartilage/synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Direct full-thickness ACL rupture and surfacing complex medial meniscal tear positive. Explicit_absence: normal MCL. Below_threshold: mild fluid. Missing_evidence: lateral free-edge tear/fraying wording is conditional (olabilir), not a settled tear morphology; tricompartmental disease with medial full-depth loss lacks deep-region extent; subchondral fibrovascular/cystic change lacks impact cause/acute line assessment. Synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: intact ACL/MCL/menisci. Below_threshold: physiologic trace fluid and no significant Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: relatively preserved cartilage/no full-depth lesion/minimal attenuation do not explicitly establish partial-depth threshold in all compartments; local lack of reactive subchondral change is not a whole-bone contusion/acute-line exclusion. Generic normal conclusion does not erase these limited statements. Synovitis unmentioned.
Only generic Sin anomalías is supplied; no target-specific structure or finding is informatively mentioned.

Direct medial meniscal rupture and contusional tibial marrow edema positive. Explicit_absence/below_threshold: intact ACL/MCL, isolated lateral meniscal degeneration, small fluid and normal popliteal fossa. Missing_evidence: anterior medial femoral osteochondral/cartilage defect and retropatellar defects lack depth/extent; 10x3.5-mm measurement belongs to a different Hoffa-region loose body, not proven cartilage-loss area. Osseous/cartilage donor morphology is not dated as acute, and normal bone structure statement is limited by described defects. Lateral cartilage/synovitis unmentioned.

Direct surfacing lateral meniscal fissure positive despite calcification background. Medial OA positive uses fully depleted compartment cartilage, qualitative broad extent. Below_threshold: markedly thickened/high-signal ACL without discontinuity is signal/thickening-only evidence; explicit normal MCL and small fluid. Missing_evidence: likely prior medial resection lacks current tear assessment; mixed superficial/deep lateral disease lacks high-grade region extent; PF has 8-mm delamination but other deep/moderate abnormalities lack extent/depth; Baker ungraded; marrow edema lacks impact/acute-line assessment. Plica is not synovitis. Flag postoperative/mucoid-versus-tear interpretations.

Direct tears of both menisci and synovitis positive. Explicit_absence: normal MCL. Missing_evidence: bare ACL tear lacks complete/high-grade fraction; global knee OA/unnamed grades3-4 lack compartment depth/extent; fluid and characteristic Baker cyst are ungraded; medial subchondral edema lacks impact cause; displaced posterior tibial fracture lacks explicit acute timing. PF uncertainty follows global cartilage/OA statement, without asserting a PF lesion. No subtype-wide fracture exclusion. Preserve source.

Explicit_absence/below_threshold: normal ACL, grade-I MCL sprain and both menisci with internal grade-I degeneration. Missing_evidence: 4x2-mm osteochondral lesion is not an explicit measurement of cartilage loss depth/region; joint fluid is ungraded; multifocal subchondral cysts/edema lack impact cause/acute line assessment. Lateral/PF cartilage/synovitis/Baker unmentioned; prepatellar edema is not fluid grade.

Subtotal ACL with only a portion of preserved fibers and explicit contusional tibial marrow edema support positives. Explicit_absence: normal menisci and remaining cartilage. Below_threshold: named ICRS1b patellar change and tiny Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: posterior MCL partial tear lacks high-grade fraction/acute MCL edema; medial ICRS3/4 fixes depth but lacks loss extent; fluid ungraded; contusion does not explicitly exclude acute line. Synovitis unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: intact ACL/MCL, normal menisci/cartilage, no fluid and unremarkable popliteal fossa. Missing_evidence: definite nonconsolidated compression fracture/line with depression and edema lacks acute timing; nonconsolidation can reflect recent injury or persistent nonunion and is not automatically acute. Fracture-associated edema is not separately diagnosed contusion. Synovitis unmentioned.

Direct synovitis positive. Explicit_absence: intact ACL/MCL, no meniscal/cartilage lesions medially/laterally and no fracture/bone contusion. Below_threshold: minimal fluid. Missing_evidence: PF defect depth is explicit but extent/delamination measurements are corrupted intact tokens; do not reconstruct decimals. Baker unmentioned.

Direct acute complete ACL rupture and medial/lateral meniscal tears positive. Explicit_absence/below_threshold: grade-I MCL sprain, no medial/PF cartilage lesion and minimal fluid. Missing_evidence: 1.3x1-cm osteochondral injury supplies lesion extent but not cartilage-loss thickness; it also lacks explicit impact marrow edema or acute cortical/line morphology despite acute ACL context. No automatic osteochondral-fracture or contusion assumption. Synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: intact cruciates and no lateral meniscal tear associated with cyst. Below_threshold: explicitly superficial femorotibial/PF fissures and minimal fluid; depth comes from morphology, not grade2 alone. Missing_evidence: laterale banden has ambiguous MCL scope; no marrow edema does not exclude an acute cortical line. Large anterolateral arthrosynovial cyst is not posterior Baker cyst or synovitis. Medial meniscus/Baker/synovitis unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: normal MCL/lateral meniscus and bone signal for contusion. Below_threshold: medial grade-II internal degeneration with mild extrusion, without definite tear. Missing_evidence: ACL partial tear lacks high-grade fraction; adjacent 12-mm cyst does not quantify tear; fluid ungraded; normal bone signal does not exclude cortical line. Cartilage/synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Nearly total ACL partial tear with fragmented morphology establishes high-grade positive independent of grade3. Explicit_absence: normal MCL, named meniscal horns and articular surfaces. Missing_evidence: Bone bruit is nonstandard and may be a corrupt bruise term; retain uncertain rather than silently repair it. Referenced tibial plateau fracture lacks acute timing/line detail. Fibular-ligament partial tear conflicts with normal lateral ligament statement but does not affect MCL. Effusion/synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: normal ACL/menisci/PF cartilage, no significant fluid or Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: MCL partial disruption/edema lacks proportion of interrupted fibers; generic tibial-plateau early degeneration does not state medial versus lateral location or depth, so both femorotibial targets uncertain rather than inventing side; femoral MCL-attachment edema lacks impact cause/acute-line assessment. Remaining normal bone signal does not cover this focal change. Synovitis unmentioned.

PF positive uses nearly completely reduced thickness of the joint articular cartilage as qualitative broad-region/depth evidence; moderate fluid positive. Below_threshold: mucoid ACL and degenerative grade-I MCL lesion. Missing_evidence: state-after-complex medial rupture and questioned flap do not clearly establish current residual tear; medial denudation lacks specified loss extent; tiny osteochondral lateral lesion lacks a direct cartilage-loss assessment; numeric-only Baker lacks grade; degenerative marrow changes lack impact/acute-line assessment. Lateral meniscal root mentioned only to locate loose body, not meniscal state. Synovitis unmentioned; tendon tenosynovitis is distinct.

Direct unstable lateral meniscal tear positive. Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL/medial meniscus. Below_threshold: mild fluid and tiny cyst. Missing_evidence: medial thinning, marked lateral thinning and patellar fissuring lack specified depth/qualifying region extent; reactive marrow changes lack impact cause/acute line assessment. Fluid around loose bodies is not synovitis; synovitis unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: normal ACL and preserved menisci/femorotibial-trochlear cartilage, no pathological popliteal cyst. Below_threshold: mild likely chronic MCL thickening without disruption, no significant fluid. Missing_evidence: fine full-thickness patellar ulcers lack regional extent; qualified no significant marrow change does not exclude contusion/acute line and secondary bone change is not direct trauma. Deep pes bursitis/fat-pad edema do not establish synovitis, which is unmentioned.

Direct medial meniscal tear and moderate fluid positive. Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL/lateral meniscus, no Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: all-compartment OA lacks depth/extent; named tibial fracture lacks acute timing. Contusion and synovitis unmentioned; fracture alone is not marrow contusion.

Direct chronic complete ACL rupture, lateral meniscal tear and moderate fluid positive. Explicit_absence: normal MCL/medial meniscus/cartilage. Below_threshold: small Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: benign red-marrow islands do not assess impact edema/acute cortical line across remaining bone. Popliteus bursitis does not establish synovitis, which is unmentioned.

Definite final medial meniscal tear and direct mild diffuse synovitis positive. Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL and preserved lateral meniscal morphology/signal. Below_threshold: mild fluid. Missing_evidence: all compartments have mixed partial/full-depth ulcers without extent of the deeper regions, despite diffuse distribution medially/PF; secondary degenerative bone changes do not establish impact/acute line. Baker unmentioned.

Explicit_absence/below_threshold: continuous heterogeneous ACL, preserved MCL/lateral meniscal outline and discrete medial meniscal degeneration. Missing_evidence: focal medial defect/thinning lacks depth/extent; increased fluid and Baker cyst ungraded; underlying inhomogeneous bone lacks impact cause/acute line. Lateral/PF cartilage/synovitis unmentioned; insertional tendon fluid is separate.

Direct lateral meniscal tear, moderate fluid and moderately large Baker cyst positive. Lateral OA positive uses denudation of the weightbearing lateral femorotibial portion as broad regional extent, flagged qualitative inference. Explicit_absence/below_threshold: intact mucoid ACL, MCL and medial meniscus. Missing_evidence: medial partial-depth defect and PF thinning/unnamed grades1-2 lack depth/extent; reactive subchondral edema lacks impact/acute line. Prepatellar bursitis does not establish synovitis. Synovitis unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: normal ligaments/cartilage, no fluid and normal marrow signal for contusion. Below_threshold: medial internal degenerative signal. Missing_evidence: lateral anterior horn tear/degeneration slash alternatives do not establish definite tear; normal marrow signal does not exclude acute cortical line. Synovitis/Baker unmentioned; fabella is variant.

Complete-to-near-complete ACL rupture and surfacing lateral vertical-oblique tear positive. Explicit_absence/below_threshold: preserved MCL, medial degeneration without tear, superficial PF irregularities and mild fluid. Missing_evidence: focal full-depth femorotibial losses lack extent despite accompanying superficial irregularities. Semimembranosus insertion ganglia are not Baker cyst; Baker/synovitis/bone injury unmentioned.

Direct complete ACL rupture, both meniscal tears, moderate fluid, reactive synovitis and named contusions positive. Explicit_absence: intact MCL/PF surface. Missing_evidence: no definite osteochondral lesion is qualified and does not settle medial cartilage depth; lateral thinning/prior osteochondral notch injury lacks loss extent/depth. Fracture retained uncertain because initial no definite fracture is qualified, prior notch injury does not exclude a separate current acute fracture. Bipartite patella not automatically fracture. Baker unmentioned.

Known current medial vertical tear and moderate effusion positive; no new tear does not erase the persisting tear. Explicit_absence/below_threshold: normal intact ACL and continuous MCL with irritative fluid, no focal marrow edema for contusion. Missing_evidence: no new meniscal tear does not explicitly exclude an older lateral tear; full-depth cartilage signal is not full-depth tissue loss, and no substantial defect is qualified; no marrow edema does not exclude acute cortical line. Medial/lateral cartilage/Baker unmentioned; plica/MPFL scar not synovitis.

Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL and no bone contusion. Below_threshold: medial internal signal without significant surface extension, possible grade2 degeneration. Missing_evidence: qualified no significant edema/active cortical destruction is not full acute-fracture exclusion. Large residual nerve-sheath ganglion along sciatic branches is not a Baker cyst. Lateral meniscus/cartilage/effusion/synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Direct complete ACL rupture, both meniscal tears and moderate/marked fluid positive. Explicit_absence/below_threshold: continuous MCL despite thickening/signal (no fiber disruption), normal cartilage thickness/signal, no Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: focal tibial edema lacks specified impact cause/acute fracture line. Synovitis unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL/lateral meniscus, normal femorotibial-trochlear cartilage and no popliteal cyst. Below_threshold: medial internal signal without tear, superficial PF chondropathy and no significant fluid. Missing_evidence: no significant marrow changes is qualified for contusion/acute line. Pes friction/tendon changes not synovitis; synovitis unmentioned.

Lateral OA positive uses explicit >50% loss and uncorrupted 1.1x1.1-cm tibial region; other corrupted femoral sizes are not reconstructed. Explicit_absence: intact ACL/MCL, no meniscal tears, no medial/PF cartilage lesion, no fracture/bone contusion. Missing_evidence: fluid ungraded. PCL suspected chronic partial tear does not affect ACL. Synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Below_threshold: small joint fluid. Missing_evidence: collective no noteworthy findings is qualified for the named menisci/ligaments/cartilage/marrow; conservatively uncertain rather than silently turning it into explicit normal findings. Benign tibial bone island is not traumatic disease but does not strengthen global injury exclusion. Flag language scope; synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Direct complex medial meniscal tear positive. Medial OA positive uses complete cartilage loss in the compartment, qualitative broad extent. Below_threshold: continuous mucoid ACL, continuous distended/signal-altered MCL, lateral degeneration without tear and small fluid. Missing_evidence: lateral thinning/unnamed III and PF unnamed II lack depth/extent; numeric-only 32-mm Baker lacks grade; edema lacks impact/acute-line assessment. Cruciate ganglia not Baker; synovitis unmentioned.

Medial OA positive uses diffuse high-grade loss, qualitative regional extent rather than only isolated full-thickness foci. Explicit_absence: normal ACL/menisci, no lateral defects/fluid/acute fracture/bone bruise. Below_threshold: chronic MCL thickening explicitly without acute edema and trace Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: focal high-grade PF fissures lack region extent. Synovitis unmentioned.

Direct surfacing lateral horizontal-oblique tear positive. Explicit_absence: intact ACL/MCL, normal bone signal for contusion and no Baker cyst. Below_threshold: medial internal degeneration without frank tear and no significant fluid. Missing_evidence: no significant chondropathy is qualified without explicit depth/extent, not a reliably mapped threshold; normal signal alone does not exclude cortical line. Suprapatellar fat impingement is not synovitis.

Direct incomplete radial lateral meniscal tear and synovitis positive. Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL/medial meniscus/cartilage and no pathological popliteal cyst. Below_threshold: mild fluid. Missing_evidence: qualified no significant marrow changes does not exclude contusion/acute line. Tendon/fat-pad friction findings are separate.

Direct medial complex tear positive. Explicit_absence: normal continuous ACL/MCL, no lateral meniscal pathology, normal patellar cartilage signal/no Baker cyst. Below_threshold: small fluid. Missing_evidence: medial thinning/unnamed III lacks depth/extent; patellar marrow edema lacks impact cause/acute-line assessment. Lateral cartilage/synovitis unmentioned.

Direct mild synovitis positive. Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL and no bone contusion. Below_threshold: medial internal grade-II signal, mild fluid and small Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: global focal cartilage wear worse medially with final bare medial III and patellar II lacks depth/extent. Lateral meniscus and fracture are not informatively assessed; no contusion does not become no fracture. Plicae are not the basis for synovitis positive.

notes: Personally read all 50 original gold-blinded reports in five groups of ten and reasoned all 600 targets under frozen rubric. No other 066 annotations, gold, legacy/external labels, regex/NLI labeling or default filling accessed/used. Python only assembled explicit personal choices and validated exact contiguous original-language quotes, schema and UID coverage through rsna.labels.read_reviews. Unfinished work stayed outside initiative. Explicit absence and below-threshold findings distinguished in notes; missing severity/extent/acuity/anatomy and contradictions masked. Only completion/coverage/hashes shared with root; flags withheld pending independent source-first review. Draft does not confer training eligibility or image diagnostic accuracy.
